note: Outfit: colorful embroidered Mexican huipil top or floral jacket, sombrero or wide-brim hat with flowers, camera pouch, rolling suitcase with cactus sticker. Each page has a unique Mexico City setting — Zócalo appears only on page 5.

scenes.setting: Benito Juárez International Airport arrivals hall
scenes.scene_description: Capybara bursts through the airport arrivals sliding doors into the warm Mexico City air, suitcase rolling behind, immediately hit by the vibrant noise and color of the arrivals hall — a huge banner of marigold flowers in bright orange hangs overhead. Body faces left, head swiveling right with enormous excited eyes. A bright green parrot companion with a red beak perches on the suitcase handle wearing a tiny charro hat, surveying the scene with great Latin flair.
scenes.pose: emerging from doors, body left, head swiveling right, wide excited eyes
scenes.background: Benito Juárez Airport arrivals hall — marigold flower garland banners overhead, bright warm light, glass exit doors behind
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Frida Kahlo museum, pyramids, street markets — only the airport arrivals hall

scenes.setting: First view of Mexico City skyline from Chapultepec Hill
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands at the top of Chapultepec Hill looking out over the vast Mexico City skyline spreading across the entire valley — millions of lights and rooftops in every direction, the Popocatépetl volcano visible as a distant snow-capped triangle on the horizon. Both arms flung wide in pure amazement, mouth open, hat blown off by the hilltop breeze. A rabbit companion in a small embroidered vest stands beside pointing excitedly at the volcano.
scenes.pose: arms wide, hat blown off, mouth open, looking at vast city panorama
scenes.background: Chapultepec Hill viewpoint — Mexico City valley spreading in all directions, Popocatépetl snow-capped volcano silhouette on the distant horizon, trees below
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids of Teotihuacan — only the hilltop city panorama and distant volcano

scenes.setting: Colorful boutique hotel room in Colonia Roma
scenes.scene_description: Capybara kneels on a bright tile floor of a colorful boutique hotel room in Colonia Roma, unpacking from the rolling suitcase onto a hand-painted wooden table — a tiny ceramic skull figure, a packet of chili candy, and a marigold flower spill out. The capybara holds up the ceramic skull with delight, head tilted. A tabby cat companion has immediately claimed the hammock in the corner and is watching with one sleepy eye open.
scenes.pose: kneeling beside suitcase, holding ceramic skull up to examine, head tilted, delighted
scenes.background: Colorful boutique hotel room interior — hand-painted Talavera tiles on floor, vivid yellow and blue walls, hammock in corner, wrought-iron window showing a courtyard
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids, street markets — only the colorful hotel room interior

scenes.setting: Street taqueria breakfast counter at dawn
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits at a tiny street taqueria counter at dawn, both paws gripping an enormous taco that is threatening to overflow with contents — the capybara's eyes are wide with the scale of the challenge. A lime wedge the size of the capybara's head sits beside. Body faces forward in focused breakfast mode. The green parrot companion has landed in the tortilla basket and is looking extremely pleased with the situation.
scenes.pose: facing viewer, gripping enormous overflowing taco in both paws, eyes wide
scenes.background: Street taqueria counter at dawn — simple counter with lime, salsa jars, tortilla baskets, the street barely visible outside with early morning light
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids, Chapultepec — only the simple taqueria counter

scenes.setting: Zócalo main plaza — THE Mexico City central square
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands in the vast empty stone expanse of the Zócalo, the enormous Mexican flag on its tall flagpole right beside them snapping in the wind, one arm raised to point dramatically at the Metropolitan Cathedral's twin bell towers dominating the far background. The capybara is intentionally tiny against the massive scale of the square. A rabbit companion crouches beside pointing a small camera up at the flag.
scenes.pose: tiny in huge plaza, one arm pointing at cathedral, looking up at massive flag
scenes.background: Zócalo main plaza — enormous stone-paved square, giant Mexican flag on tall flagpole, Metropolitan Cathedral twin bell towers in background, government palace to one side
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Pyramids, Chapultepec, Frida museum — this is THE Zócalo page, the only one showing this plaza

scenes.setting: Frida Kahlo Museum (La Casa Azul) in Coyoacán
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands outside La Casa Azul — the intensely cobalt blue exterior wall of the Frida Kahlo Museum — holding a tiny camera up to one eye, squinting, photographing the vivid blue facade covered in climbing plants. Body faces the blue wall. A tabby cat companion poses dramatically against the blue wall like a fashion model, clearly ready for the photo.
scenes.pose: photographer's stance at blue wall, camera to eye, squinting
scenes.background: La Casa Azul exterior — the famous intensely cobalt blue painted wall with climbing plants, the distinctive blue of the Frida Kahlo Museum in Coyoacán
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids — only the famous blue wall of La Casa Azul

scenes.setting: Mercado de Jamaica flower market
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands in the Mercado de Jamaica flower market completely surrounded by enormous bouquets of marigolds, roses, and tropical flowers in every color — the flowers tower above the capybara's head on all sides. One paw reaches out to touch an enormous orange marigold. Facing left, nearly hidden by flowers. A rabbit companion in a flower crown pokes their head through a wall of roses from behind.
scenes.pose: nearly hidden by towering flower bouquets, one paw reaching out to touch marigold, facing left
scenes.background: Mercado de Jamaica flower market — enormous bundles of marigolds, roses, tropical flowers towering on all sides, stall canvas overhead
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids, Frida museum — only the flower market

scenes.setting: Street vendor cart with elote (Mexican street corn)
scenes.scene_description: Capybara holds a fully loaded elote — corn on the cob covered in mayonnaise, cotija cheese, chili, and lime — up toward their face with both paws, eyes crossed trying to figure out the best first bite angle. Body faces forward. The green parrot companion sits on the cart wheel watching with professional food critic judgment, head tilted.
scenes.pose: facing viewer, holding giant elote up to face, eyes crossed deciding attack angle
scenes.background: Street corn vendor cart — simple wheeled cart with corn supplies, chili jars, a bright street umbrella, colorful street backdrop
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids — only the simple street corn cart

scenes.setting: Bosque de Chapultepec park lake with rowboats
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits in a colorfully painted rowboat on Chapultepec Park's main lake, both oars raised dripping, leaning back in complete relaxation, face tipped up to dappled light through willow trees. Expression of pure urban-escapism bliss. A tabby cat companion sits in the bow with legs neatly folded, tail wrapped around, watching the passing ducks with an expression of deep philosophical contentment.
scenes.pose: leaning back in rowboat, oars raised dripping, face tilted up to sunlight
scenes.background: Chapultepec Park lake — willow trees overhanging the green water, other colorful rowboats in the distance, Chapultepec Castle hill visible through the trees
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids, flower market — only the Chapultepec park lake

scenes.setting: Xochimilco canals — meeting an axolotl
scenes.scene_description: Capybara leans over the edge of a colorful trajinera flower boat on the Xochimilco canals, both paws on the wooden rail, nose nearly touching the water as they come face to face with a tiny smiling axolotl — the unique pink salamander of Mexico City — floating directly below. Both stare at each other in complete fascination, the axolotl grinning its famous permanent smile. The trajinera boat is decorated with paper flowers.
scenes.pose: leaning over flower boat rail, nose near water, face to face with axolotl below
scenes.background: Xochimilco canal — colorful paper-flower-decorated trajinera boat, green canal water, willow trees trailing on both sides, other flower boats in distance
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids, Chapultepec castle — only the Xochimilco canals and flower boats

scenes.setting: Mexico City Metro — iconic rubber-wheeled subway
scenes.scene_description: Capybara hangs from an overhead Metro pole with both paws, feet swinging as the train sways, sombrero hat tilted at a steep angle, expression mixing excitement and mild panic. Body faces right in profile. A rabbit companion has somehow found a seat and is reading a folded newspaper with the composed expression of a seasoned commuter.
scenes.pose: hanging from metro pole, feet swinging, sombrero tilted, facing right
scenes.background: Mexico City Metro car interior — overhead handrails, Metro station name signs in bold graphic style visible through windows, tiled station platform
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids, flower market — only the Metro interior

scenes.setting: Palacio de Bellas Artes — the art nouveau/art deco landmark
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits cross-legged on the wide stone steps of the Palacio de Bellas Artes, sketchbook on knees, drawing the extraordinary white marble dome and art nouveau facade of the palace — a building that seems to belong to a dream. Tongue slightly out in concentration. The green parrot companion perches on the capybara's hat watching the drawing with tilted head.
scenes.pose: cross-legged on steps, sketchbook on knees, tongue slightly out, drawing palace
scenes.background: Palacio de Bellas Artes front steps and facade — the magnificent white marble domed art nouveau palace, ornate exterior details, wide stone steps leading up. A completely different landmark from the Zócalo
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids — only the Palacio de Bellas Artes

scenes.setting: Mercado de Artesanías craft market for souvenirs
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands holding up an enormous sombrero hat that completely covers both the capybara and the hat they're already wearing — it's the most spectacular hat imaginable. Both paws raised to hold the brim, disappearing beneath it. Facing the viewer, invisible from hat down. A cat companion beside holds up an equally impressive tiny mini-sombrero, making the comparison delightful.
scenes.pose: facing viewer, holding giant sombrero over entire upper body, hidden beneath it
scenes.background: Artisan craft market stall interior — rows of colorful sombreros, Talavera pottery, embroidered textiles, Day of the Dead crafts hanging everywhere
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Palacio de Bellas Artes — only the craft market stall interior

scenes.setting: Alebrijes painting workshop in Coyoacán
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits at a painting table in a Coyoacán workshop carefully painting an alebrije — a fantastical painted wooden animal figure — with a tiny brush, face bent close in delighted concentration, tongue out. The alebrije they're painting looks like a tiny capybara with dragon wings. A rabbit companion at the next table has produced an alebrije that looks suspiciously like a rabbit with a crown.
scenes.pose: bent close over painting table, tiny brush in paw, tongue out painting alebrije
scenes.background: Alebrijes workshop interior — colorful painted animal sculptures on shelves, paint pots and brushes on tables, a Coyoacán courtyard glimpsed through a window
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, flower market — only the alebrije workshop interior

scenes.setting: Templo Mayor ruins in the historical center
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands at the base of the excavated Templo Mayor pyramid ruins, head craned back to look at the layered stone tiers rising above. One paw touches the ancient stone wall reverently, clearly overwhelmed by the age and history. The capybara is small against the scale of the ruins. A parrot companion perches on a nearby informational sign, puffing chest proudly.
scenes.pose: small at pyramid base, head tilted back, one paw on ancient stone, awestruck
scenes.background: Templo Mayor Aztec ruins — excavated stone pyramid tiers rising in layers, archaeological site stretching around, modern buildings of the historical center visible beyond the ruins
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo open square, Teotihuacan pyramids outside the city — only the Templo Mayor ruins in the city center

scenes.setting: Chapultepec Castle — the hilltop castle with panoramic views
scenes.scene_description: Capybara leans on the stone balcony railing of Chapultepec Castle looking out over Mexico City stretching in every direction — the Paseo de la Reforma boulevard a straight line of trees cutting through the urban density. Profile facing right, expression peaceful and awestruck. A cat companion sits on the parapet beside with tail curled, gazing out with equal serenity.
scenes.pose: leaning on castle balcony railing, profile right, gazing at city panorama
scenes.background: Chapultepec Castle stone balcony — looking out over Mexico City panorama with Paseo de la Reforma avenue cutting through the city, distant mountains on the horizon
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Templo Mayor — only the Chapultepec Castle balcony view

scenes.setting: Churro stand in a leafy Condesa neighborhood plaza
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands at a churro cart holding a freshly fried churro the length of their arm, dipped halfway into a cup of thick chocolate sauce, staring at it with the reverent focus of someone about to eat something legendary. Body faces forward. A rabbit companion beside them has their own churro already dunked entirely into the chocolate and is experiencing total happiness.
scenes.pose: facing viewer, holding arm-length churro half-dipped in chocolate, reverent stare
scenes.background: Condesa plaza churro cart — tree-lined art deco plaza, fountain in background, leafy benches, neighborhood buildings around
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Chapultepec Castle, pyramids — only the quiet Condesa plaza

scenes.setting: Día de Muertos (Day of the Dead) ofrenda altar
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits cross-legged before an elaborate Day of the Dead ofrenda altar decorated with marigold arches, candles, framed photos, and offerings — carefully placing one last marigold blossom on the altar with great care and tenderness. Expression warm and respectful. A parrot companion holds a small candle in both wings, also watching the altar with quiet reverence. The ofrenda glows warmly.
scenes.pose: cross-legged before ofrenda altar, gently placing marigold, tender expression
scenes.background: Día de Muertos ofrenda altar — marigold arch above, candles, framed photos, sugar skulls, offerings. Warm candlelight fills the scene
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Chapultepec, pyramids — only the intimate ofrenda altar scene

scenes.setting: Cantina restaurant dinner in Roma Norte neighborhood
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits at a cantina table with an enormous platter of enchiladas in deep red mole sauce before them, both paws gripping a fork and knife raised ready to dive in, eyes huge with anticipation. The platter is dramatically larger than the capybara. A cat companion across the table is already halfway through their mole, sauce on both ears, clearly having made excellent life choices.
scenes.pose: at cantina table, fork and knife raised, eyes huge at enormous mole platter
scenes.background: Roma Norte cantina interior — warm terra cotta walls, hanging papel picado banners, dim candle lighting, classic Mexican cantina atmosphere
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, street market, ofrenda altar — only the cantina interior

scenes.setting: Paseo de la Reforma boulevard at golden hour
scenes.scene_description: Capybara strolls along the wide Paseo de la Reforma boulevard at golden hour, marigold flowers in hand, looking up at the famous Angel of Independence monument — the golden winged angel atop its tall column glowing in the evening light. Profile facing right. A rabbit companion strolls beside, also gazing upward at the monument.
scenes.pose: strolling profile right, marigold flowers in hand, looking up at Angel monument
scenes.background: Paseo de la Reforma boulevard at golden hour — the tall Angel of Independence column with winged angel glowing gold, tree-lined boulevard stretching behind
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Chapultepec Castle, Día de Muertos — only the Reforma boulevard and Angel monument

scenes.setting: National Museum of Anthropology — main hall with Aztec Sun Stone
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands before the enormous Aztec Sun Stone (Aztec calendar stone) displayed in the National Museum of Anthropology — head craned all the way back to see its full circular scale, both arms at sides, jaw open in awe. The stone is deliberately drawn enormous relative to the tiny capybara below. A parrot companion examines a nearby exhibit case with scholarly interest.
scenes.pose: tiny below the giant Sun Stone, head craned back, arms at sides, jaw open
scenes.background: National Museum of Anthropology interior — the massive circular Aztec Sun Stone filling the upper frame in its museum display, high museum ceiling above, surrounding exhibit cases
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Templo Mayor ruins — only the museum interior with the Sun Stone

scenes.setting: Cycling along the Sunday Ciclovía on Reforma
scenes.scene_description: Capybara pedals a bright rental bicycle along Reforma during the Sunday Ciclovía when the boulevard is closed to cars, leaning into the ride with flowers tucked in the basket, the city traffic-free and joyful around. Heading right, speed lines behind. A cat companion pedals a matching bicycle alongside, scarf flying.
scenes.pose: cycling right at speed, leaning forward, flowers in basket, speed lines
scenes.background: Paseo de la Reforma Sunday Ciclovía — the wide boulevard car-free with cyclists everywhere, tree canopy overhead, the Angel of Independence visible far ahead on the boulevard
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Chapultepec Castle, Zócalo, pyramids — only the Reforma boulevard cycling scene

scenes.setting: Xochimilco — sitting on a trajinera flower boat
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits on the edge of a colorfully decorated trajinera flat boat on the Xochimilco canals, feet dangling above the green water, watching mariachi music being played by musicians on a passing boat — one paw tapping along to the rhythm. A rabbit companion beside has started dancing in place. Paper flowers frame the scene.
scenes.pose: sitting on boat edge, feet dangling, one paw tapping rhythm, watching mariachis
scenes.background: Xochimilco trajinera boat from a different angle than page 10 — the boat edge, paper flower decorations on sides, a mariachi boat alongside, canal water and willow trees
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, pyramids, Chapultepec — only the Xochimilco flower boat canal

scenes.setting: Lucha libre wrestling arena
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits front-row at a lucha libre wrestling match, both fists raised and cheering wildly as a masked wrestler leaps through the air in the ring below, hat flying off from excitement, expression of absolute electric joy. Body angled toward the ring. A parrot companion beside has put on a tiny lucha libre mask and is shadow-wrestling in the aisle.
scenes.pose: front-row seat, both fists raised, hat flying, angled toward ring, cheering
scenes.background: Lucha libre arena interior — the brightly lit wrestling ring below, rows of colored seats arching around, dramatic spotlights, the masked wrestler in mid-leap
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Chapultepec, pyramids — only the lucha libre arena interior

scenes.setting: Bazar del Sábado Saturday artisan market in San Ángel
scenes.scene_description: Capybara holds up an enormous hand-painted ceramic Talavera sun face — a round ceramic platter painted with a radiating sun and flowers nearly as wide as the capybara's full arm span — weighing it admiringly. Facing the viewer, elbows up, barely visible behind the ceramic. A cat companion beside them holds a tiny matching miniature Talavera sun face with self-satisfied comparison.
scenes.pose: facing viewer, holding giant Talavera sun ceramic at full arm span, barely visible
scenes.background: Bazar del Sábado San Ángel market — colonial courtyard with artisan stalls, Talavera pottery, hand-painted ceramics and folk art everywhere
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Chapultepec, Lucha libre — only the San Ángel Saturday market

scenes.setting: Grito de Independencia (Mexican Independence celebration) in the Zócalo — evening
scenes.scene_description: Capybara dances in the edge of the huge Independence Day crowd, both arms raised holding a small Mexican flag, marigold garland around their neck, face lit by fireworks above — the fireworks are drawn as simple starburst outline patterns, NOT filled black sky. The background sky is PURE WHITE with small star outline dots and simple line firework starburst patterns. A rabbit, parrot, and cat companion dance alongside in a joyful circle. Confetti falls as outline dots only. The entire scene has only white and black — no dark fills, no black sky, no gray tones anywhere.
scenes.pose: both arms raised with small flag, marigold garland around neck, dancing joyfully
scenes.background: Zócalo at night during Grito de Independencia — the plaza packed with celebration, fireworks bursting in the sky above the Metropolitan Cathedral, warm night atmosphere. This is the NIGHT version of the Zócalo, very different from the daytime page 5
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo daytime version, black sky fills, dark backgrounds, gray fills, any filled black areas — only white background with star dots and firework outline patterns

scenes.setting: Coyoacán neighborhood plaza farewell
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands in the Coyoacán main plaza for a warm farewell, holding a small hand-painted alebrije figure as a parting gift toward the parrot companion, while the rabbit companion holds out a marigold bouquet, the cat gives a warm hug, and an axolotl waves from a small water-filled jar. All friends with sparkly teary happy eyes.
scenes.pose: center of farewell circle, giving alebrije to parrot, receiving marigold from rabbit
scenes.background: Coyoacán neighborhood plaza — colorful colonial-era church in background, leafy jacaranda trees, cobblestone plaza, warm afternoon light
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, Lucha libre, pyramids — only the quiet Coyoacán plaza

scenes.setting: Hotel room departure morning
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits on top of an impossibly overstuffed suitcase trying to force it shut — an enormous sombrero, a giant Talavera ceramic sun face, alebrije figures, and marigold garlands all prevent the zipper from closing. Expression of cheerful determination. A cat companion sits on the floor with a clipboard assessing the situation skeptically.
scenes.pose: sitting on suitcase, feet pressing lid, arms spread for balance, facing forward
scenes.background: Hotel room interior departure morning — Talavera tile floor, colorful walls, window showing Mexico City street below in morning light
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, any landmark — only the hotel room interior with sunrise through window

scenes.setting: Benito Juárez Airport departure gate
scenes.scene_description: Capybara stands at the airport departure gate window with one paw flat against the glass, looking back with bittersweet sparkly eyes at the Mexico City skyline visible beyond the tarmac — the Popocatépetl volcano a tiny snow-capped silhouette on the horizon. Smiling bravely. The green parrot companion perches on the rolling suitcase, wing raised in a final farewell salute.
scenes.pose: paw on gate window, looking back over shoulder, bittersweet smile
scenes.background: Airport departure gate window — Mexico City urban skyline across the tarmac, Popocatépetl volcano silhouette on distant horizon
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Zócalo, market, Coyoacán — only the airport gate glass and city horizon

scenes.setting: Floor spread of Mexico City mementos
scenes.scene_description: Capybara sits cross-legged in the center of an overhead spread of Mexico City memories: Polaroid photos of the Zócalo, Chapultepec Castle, axolotl encounter, and lucha libre; a tiny alebrije; a marigold flower; a Talavera ceramic fragment; a metro ticket; an elote wrapper; a small ceramic skull; a mini-sombrero. Capybara holds up a Polaroid of the Angel of Independence, smiling broadly. A rabbit companion holds the alebrije and the ceramic skull.
scenes.pose: cross-legged center, holding Angel of Independence Polaroid up, overhead view
scenes.background: Simple floor or table surface — all Mexico City mementos radiating outward in scrapbook arrangement, no architectural background
scenes.forbidden_backgrounds: Any Mexico City architecture — only the overhead mementos spread

landmarks: Zócalo; Chapultepec Castle; Palacio de Bellas Artes; Angel of Independence; Templo Mayor; Frida Kahlo Museum
